A PDE animation is only the beginning. How do you check the numerical result behind it?

PhaseAtlas connects editable PDEs, animated experiments, controlled refinement and reproducible exports in a browser workbench. Two examples link practical boundary cooling with my earlier research on a fourth-order travelling front.

The current Robin eigenmode benchmark shows approximately second-order spatial convergence. Researchers can compare parameter-dependent responses, inspect boundary balance, and separate wave motion from deformation. Failed or unresolved observations remain visible.

Developed with AI assistance; numerical computation runs locally without a runtime LLM API. This is scientific software and numerical evidence, not a new stability theorem or an experimentally calibrated engineering prediction.

Niu Te | Imperial College London
Source: https://github.com/NIU-55383/PhaseAtlas
